entities.summary: Margaret Beryl Jones, Baroness Jones of Whitchurch is a British Labour Peer and previously a trade union official and Labour politician. She was Chair of the Labour Party from 2000 to 2001. She served as Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State for the Future Digital Economy and Online Safety and as a Baroness in Waiting from July 2024 to September 2025.
